problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are:
* Package 1: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 49 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 65 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 34 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 59 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 61 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 33 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 61 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 59 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 45 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Each package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
